records.rationale: Retain deferred ID acquisition via UnusedId holding an exclusive mutable IdPool borrow. Rust Binder insert_or_update_handle performs fallible reservations/rechecks before committing its handle; only acquire sets the bit. Dropping an unused token leaves the bit free, while the borrow prevents another safe mutable pool access from racing it. as_u32 is bounded by the pool MAX_LEN=i32::MAX invariant. Grow/shrink allocate outside the caller lock and revalidate before replacing/copying the bitmap. Native C bitmap bounds checks remain; this review does not independently certify all Binder lock interleavings.

records.rationale: Retain ARef equality delegated to the referenced type, for both ARef and borrowed references. This adds no reference transfer, dereference without ownership or new allocation. Configured Rust Binder compares its pinned process Task with the current group leader to reject operations from another process; the matching Task equality uses object identity. Generic ARef equality is not unconditionally pointer equality and the rationale does not assume it is.

records.rationale: Retain KVVec::shrink_to used by configured Rust Binder Context::deregister_process to release excess process-list capacity. It clamps capacity to at least len/minimum, handles ZST/no-op/empty cases, and leaves the original vector intact on allocation failure. Kmalloc delegates to the native allocator; vmalloc allocates first, copies initialized elements without dropping them, frees old raw storage, and preserves alignment/layout. Size arithmetic is bounded by the existing valid ArrayLayout and target_cap<=capacity. LTS reserve/extend documentation corrections remain. This is a source review and successful compilation, not allocator fault-injection or runtime shrinking verification.
